title: Writing Activity YAML
description: Schema for a writing activity: a split-screen Markdown editor with an AI writing coach. Kept in sync by hand with the Zod schema in lib/writing-schema.ts, which is the source of truth for validation.

id.description: Short machine-readable activity id, e.g. human-animal-short-story.

name.description: Optional human-readable title (used as a label).

title.description: Optional greeting shown to students on the welcome screen instead of the default message.

description.description: Optional description shown to students below the welcome greeting (Markdown).

anonymous.description: Writing DIVERGES: it defaults to false (attributed), because review and the Save feature need to know whose text it is. Set to true for ephemeral, unattributed writing — which also disables saving.

instructions.description: The writing coach's system prompt. SERVER-ONLY: never sent to the browser, so it may describe the assessment criteria and coaching strategy.

placeholder.description: Optional starter text prefilled into the editor. Empty for a blank page.

model.description: The model that drives the feedback chat.
